examples.title: Hodge Decomposition
examples.content: On a compact Kahler manifold, each cohomology class has a unique harmonic representative, and the cohomology decomposes by bidegree.

examples.title: Laplacian Operators
examples.content: The Hodge Laplacian Delta = d d* + d* d equals 2 times the Dolbeault Laplacian on Kahler manifolds.

simulator.title: Harmonic Forms on Torus
simulator.description: The 2-torus has b_1 = 2 harmonic 1-forms corresponding to the two independent cycles.

applications.title: Algebraic Geometry
applications.description: Hodge theory constrains the topology of algebraic varieties through Hodge structures.

applications.title: Mirror Symmetry
applications.description: Mirror pairs exchange Hodge numbers h^{p,q} with h^{n-p,q}.

concepts.name: Harmonic Form
concepts.definition: A form omega with Delta omega = 0, equivalently satisfying d omega = d* omega = 0.

concepts.name: Hodge Star
concepts.definition: The operator *: A^k -> A^{n-k} defined by alpha wedge *beta = <alpha, beta> vol.

exercises.question: Show that on a compact Riemannian manifold, harmonic forms are closed and co-closed.
exercises.hint: Use the identity <Delta omega, omega> = ||d omega||^2 + ||d* omega||^2.

exercises.question: Prove that h^{p,q} = h^{q,p} for a compact Kahler manifold using complex conjugation.
exercises.hint: Show that conjugation interchanges (p,q) and (q,p) forms while preserving harmonicity.

diagrams.title: Hodge Diamond
diagrams.description: Visualize the Hodge numbers h^{p,q} arranged in a diamond pattern.
diagrams.instructions: The symmetries of the diamond reflect Hodge duality and complex conjugation.
